verdict.rationale: Docusign can be driven without its UI through its documented eSignature REST API, the official Node.js client library and an official MCP server. Community reports confirm production API integrations (e.g. a Postman POC and a service built by a junior developer), and agreement processes can be automated from a terminal by pairing Gemini CLI with Docusign MCP. However, nothing documents headless or CI-pipeline use specifically, and there is no first-party CLI. missing for 10: official first-party CLI, documented CI/headless pipeline guidance (service-account auth for CI, non-interactive runs), independent corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Official Docusign Node.js Client Library used to interact with the eSign REST API. Send, sign, and approve documents using this client.
